My dear [Gertrude](/person/751)
I hope your chapter[^1] will be of a length that will fit happily into July. I will do my best for its coming in. Here is your Twilight[^2] which please look over, and it will get in when there is room. I do not think I am likely to come to London I have had two outings - to Chichester in Easter week and last week to the laying the 1st stone of [Keble Chapel](/organisation/5) and I don't think I shall make much of an expedition till the opening of [Mr Wither](/person/1544)'s Church I wish Crawley was on this side Winchester[^3]
yours very sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: The first chapter of G.L.J., \'The English Raja: James Brooke\', was published in MP 16 (August 1873) 135-46, which ran until August 1874, and was published as Gertrude L. Jacob, The Raja of Saráwak : An account of Sir James Brooke, K.C.B., LL.D., given chiefly through letters and journals (London: Macmillan 1876).
[^2]: G. L. J., \'Twilight\' MP ns 16 (July 1873) 100-104.
[^3]: Jacob\'s father was Rector of Crawley, near Winchester.
